subject: [hw] V41 -> root: first-phone-encode blockers in daemon/vcodecd.c: fds (fixed on my side) + wait_done call (IP)
body:
Two daemon-side blockers for the first phone encode, both in daemon/vcodecd.c handle_enc_frame() (posted to hw-ip with exact text):

1. The call is n2ap_venc_encode(...) with the 0/0 wrapper, but the interpreted libvpud_vcodec ring buffer ion_import()s input_fd[0]/bs_fd; fd 0 logs "ion_import failed" and yields bs_size 0. I made n2ap_venc_encode() auto-publish both handles through V34's weak n2shim_ion_register_share() (stable ids 0x520..0x55f), so IP's current call works unchanged; encode_fd() still allows explicit ids.
2. After the async ENCODE_ACK the size/key arrive only in PUT_BUFFER/list_free, so res.bytes is 0 at return. The daemon must call n2ap_venc_wait_done(g.s.enc, g.hw_timeout_ms, &res) when r == 0 && res.bytes == 0, exactly as IV's runner does; without it every real frame is rejected as "bad encode size".

V41 itself: N2TEST V41 PASS 639/639; host/run_vhost.sh and fakevenc/run_session.sh validate a 115841-byte 320x240 H.264 stream on the plain tree. No phone access from me.
